pdf_extraction: Same whitespace-delimited tokens as clinical-note.txt; line wrapping and blank lines may differ.
text_pseudonymization: The text and PDF-derived outputs must be nonempty and differ from their respective input texts beyond whitespace.

scope: These checks demonstrate the SQL functions on fictional data. They do not establish complete identifier removal or clinical de-identification accuracy. Pseudonyms can change with model or dependency versions.
